read_scope: Three primary abstract and bibliography pages only. No full-paper or appendix replication.

sources.title: Programming Refusal with Conditional Activation Steering
sources.supported: Inference-time conditional activation steering already exists.
sources.boundary: Do not extract or fit a condition/steering vector for this study.

sources.title: GAPS: Dimension-Level Gates for Conditional Activation Steering
sources.supported: Conditional control over when and which dimensions to steer already exists.
sources.boundary: Do not adopt statistical separability, Gaussian posterior or tuned activation gates; the proposed recognizer is fixed syntax, not a fitted model.

sources.title: LLMs program using Reusable and Composable Abstract Representations
sources.supported: Manipulating code function,language and implementation through activation steering is prior work.
sources.boundary: Its fine-tuning and trained synthetic-model experiments are prohibited here. No claim that this native-channel controller reproduces its abstractions.

decision: No new method or capability claim. Fixed syntax-triggered native gains need direct executable evidence and separate confirmation.
